feature.name: Character encoding flexibility
feature.description: XML supports multiple encodings (e.g., UTF-8, UTF-16, ISO-8859-1), declared in the XML declaration (e.g., <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>).

feature.name: XML Signature Reference transforms
feature.description: Supports preprocessing of referenced data (e.g., base64 decoding, XPath filtering, canonicalization) before signature computation.
